description: Returns a ready to paste reference for one paper in APA, MLA or BibTeX, built from the OpenAlex record. Parts the record does not have, such as authors or a venue, are left out instead of invented, so check the result against the paper before you hand it in. A wrong or unknown reference returns a not found error that suggests searching by title or checking the DOI format. Inputs: paper (required, a DOI like 10.1038/nature14539, a doi.org link, or an OpenAlex id like W2741809807), style (required, apa, mla or bibtex). Example prompt: 'give me an APA citation for DOI 10.1038/nature14539.'

paper.description: A DOI like 10.1038/nature14539, a doi.org link, or an OpenAlex id like W2741809807.

style.description: The citation style: apa, mla or bibtex.
